## Highlights

- Install go-schedule on Windows with user-controlled shortcuts and completion actions, a bounded first window, reliable service access, and guided preserve-or-wipe removal.
- Use a polished desktop interface with light and dark modes, selectable fonts, responsive navigation and scrolling, readable interaction states, and compact storage-path information.
- Create tasks from a natural command line, edit them by double-clicking, and understand Tasks, Schedule, and Activity through labeled, responsive tables with consistent event semantics.
- Run manual and scheduled tasks reliably through the installed LocalSystem service, with distinct diagnostics for child failures, startup failures, access denial, timeouts, and reconnect recovery.
- Trust the v1 release boundary through draft-only staging, exact-candidate Windows qualification, candidate-bound evidence, complete asset checksums, and promotion without rebuilding artifacts.

Read the [full changelog](https://github.com/shruggietech/go-schedule/blob/v1.0.0/CHANGELOG.md#100---2026-09-03) for every change.
